spells.name: Hard as Diamond
spells.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Petrifex Elite Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Skeletal Grasp
spells.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target's Move characteristic
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Petrifex Elite Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Tremors From the Entombed
spells.effect:
If the target is a terrain feature, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of it. On a 2+. inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
If the unit is a faction terrain feature, inflict 2D6 mortal damage on it, If the target is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of it. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Petrifex Elite Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a terrain feature or faction terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
